newsitem.title: USA: Experts pick telecoms in changing industry - paper.
newsitem.headline: Experts pick telecoms in changing industry - paper.

text.p: In an ever changing regulatory climate in the global telecommunications industry, firms are rushing to merge and forge alliances with other companies in a battle for market share and profits, Barron's reported.

According to three Wall Street experts cited by Barron's, the best investments will likely include Latin American firms, including Telefonica del Peru and Telebras SA, as well as other Brazilian regionals. Other favorites include Spain's Telefonica de Espana, MCI Communications Corp, and some Japanese telecom firms.

Barron's reported that the panel expects successful firms to be those that can control a phone call from the point of origin to the point of destination with their own assets. Investors also need to start looking at cash flows instead of reported earnings, the Wall Street experts said.
